```python
script = '''import openpyxl
import json

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook("CUGA_generalist_agent/.cuga/env/testbed/data/order_summary.xlsx", data_only=True)

all_data = {}
for sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[sheet_name]
    sheet_data = []
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=ws.max_row, max_col=ws.max_column, values_only=False):
        row_data = []
        for cell in row:
            val = cell.value
            if val is not None:
                row_data.append({"cell": cell.coordinate, "value": str(val)})
            else:
                row_data.append({"cell": cell.coordinate, "value": ""})
        sheet_data.append(row_data)
    all_data[sheet_name] = {
        "dimensions": f"{ws.max_row} rows x {ws.max_column} cols",
        "rows": sheet_data
    }

# Build a readable text output
lines = []
for sheet_name, info in all_data.items():
    lines.append(f"=== Sheet: {sheet_name} ({info['dimensions']}) ===")
    lines.append("")
    for row in info["rows"]:
        row_str = " | ".join(f"{c['cell']}: {c['value']}" for c in row)
        lines.append(row_str)
    lines.append("")

text_output = "\\n".join(lines)

# Also save as JSON for structured review
with open("output/order_summary_extracted.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(text_output)

with open("output/order_summary_extracted.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(all_data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

print(text_output[:3000])
print("\\n... (truncated if long)")
print(f"\\nTotal sheets: {len(all_data)}")
for sn, si in all_data.items():
    print(f"  Sheet '{sn}': {si['dimensions']}")
print("\\nFiles saved to output/order_summary_extracted.txt and output/order_summary_extracted.json")
'''

await run_command("mkdir -p output")
await write_file("./extract_excel.py", script)
extract_result = await run_command("python ./extract_excel.py")
print(extract_result)

extracted_txt = await read_file("./output/order_summary_extracted.txt")
print(extracted_txt)
```
